description: An impossible witness prefix leaves a long captured body shared. Its unit alternatives have different closes.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $x(body)
%conditions ¬begins(from(without-elision($x)), other)
%rule body 'x' {unit}
%rule unit 'a' [+T] | 'a' [+U]
%rule other 'z'
